g.title: Long shot. A street at night. Alice, centre, hands on hips, angry, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, arms crossed, coy. Bob: You wouldn't dare.
Medium shot. A street at night. Alice, left, pointing, shouting. Alice, shouting: Watch me!
Full shot. A street at night. Bob, centre, arms crossed, surprised.
Medium shot. A street at night. Alice, centre, surprised.
Full shot. A street at night. Bob, centre, hands on hips, laughing. Bob: Missed.
Medium shot. A street at night. Alice, centre, angry.
